clue.text: Affectedly attractive hairstyle? Yes after perm

taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.walkthrough: 'Perm' looks like part of the hairdressing picture, but here it is short for permutation.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutesy describes something sweet in a mannered, overdone way, the sense of affected charm.

taken as written

clue.text: A target that's disputed? It could involve a lot of rowing

clue.text: Give away sales outlet

clue.text: Comical element in skeleton for audience

clue.text: Worry member in part of golf course?

opening letter
opening letter

rearranged

clue.text: Pithy form of daily prayer (not half)

taken as written, its first half kept
